Bollywood Nightmare takes over Stadium Sports Grill Oct 31! DJ Ravi, spooky vibes & Bollywood beats all night. Free entry before 10 PM!

About this Event

🎃 BOLLYWOOD NIGHTMARE – HALLOWEEN PARTY 2026ENTER IF YOU DARE!
This Halloween, the nightmare begins at Stadium Sports Grill!
Get ready for the most thrilling Bollywood Halloween celebration as BOLLYWOOD NIGHTMARE takes over Addison on Saturday, October 31, 2026!
When Bollywood meets Halloween, expect a night filled with haunting beats, mysterious vibes, spooky surprises, and nonstop dancing!
Step into a world of darkness, glamour, and electrifying music where the Halloween spirit comes alive. Whether you're a Bollywood fanatic, a Halloween enthusiast, or simply looking for an unforgettable Saturday night, this is the party you don't want to miss!

🎧 MUSIC BY DJ RAVIPrepare for a spine-chilling musical experience as DJ RAVI takes control of the dance floor!
🔥 Bollywood Party Anthems
🔥 High-Energy Desi Dance Hits
🔥 Spooky Halloween Party Vibes
🔥 Nonstop Bollywood Beats All Night
From iconic Bollywood favorites to electrifying dance tracks, DJ Ravi will keep the energy alive until the night is over!

👻 WHAT TO EXPECT🎃 Halloween Atmosphere – Step into a night inspired by mystery, horror, and Bollywood glamour.
💀 Bollywood Meets Horror – A thrilling combination of spooky Halloween energy and your favorite Desi beats.
🦇 Halloween Costumes – Dress in your scariest, boldest, or most glamorous Halloween look and bring your nightmare character to life!
🔥 Nonstop Dancing – Experience a dance floor powered by DJ Ravi's electrifying Bollywood mixes.
📸 Unforgettable Moments – Bring your crew, capture your Halloween looks, and make memories worth sharing!

📍 EVENT DETAILS📅 Date: Saturday, October 31, 2026
🕘 Time: 9 PM Onwards
📍 Venue: Stadium Sports Grill
📌 Address: 4872 Belt Line Rd, Addison, TX 75254
🎧 Music By: DJ RAVI
🎶 Music: Bollywood Beats All Night
🎟️ FREE ENTRY BEFORE 10 PM
🚗 FREE PARKING AVAILABLE

🩸 THE NIGHTMARE BEGI
